items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Four Chicks and Chuck, a vocal group who were stars on the Kate Smith Show.

ctx.x: The first time I was ever in jail was when I went to Lexington

with Clarence Page. We decided to buy a gallon of moonshine whiskey in Covington, Ky., because it was cheaper than in Lexington someone said. We had some other jobs after Lexington and a gallon of juice would last for a time if we took it easy. We had a few swallows before we left to play the dance. We were all staying in a big rooming house owned by a woman named Kate and all the rooms were on the ground floor. Dan Logan and I were staying together, but Dan didn't drink.

I always had a good time when I went to Lexington and the dance was a jumping one. When it was finished, we had some food in a late morning restaurant and came back to Kate's place and brought out the jug. Dan went to bed and we all gathered in one room and started to drink.
